headline: Five o'clock. Clouds thin over the roofs.
body: Fifteen degrees under partly cloudy skies, wind from the west near twenty with gusts past forty. Streets remain dry while evening traffic fills the near lanes. The sun lowers but still finds the tiles between the gaps.
